control.method: Unchanged test code and production code; only five destinations’ content, research metadata and editorial review JSON restored from HEAD in an isolated temporary workspace. Real workspace never rolled back or backdated.

note: An earlier clock alone cannot make a later approval valid. The matched historical-data control determines whether the 107 failures conceal a regression.
